answer: Because the dune calculation reruns each epoch, the haven weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the ivory settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 62% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A tight ring of 195 clones hence holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
